task.title: Wire hosted startup session to /bff/me before local role fallback
task.summary_zh: Hosted Lovable startup 會打 live BFF list/v5/SSE routes，但目前未在 startup 請求 /bff/me；TopBar 仍由 local platform role control 顯示 admin。需要接上 /bff/me 作為 current-user/session source，401 時顯示 auth/error state，且不得 fallback 到 mock current-user。F01 已在 test annotation 與 startup-bff-network attachment 記錄此 gap。
acceptance: hosted startup requests /bff/me before showing current-user or role UI
/bff/me 401 renders auth or error state and never falls back to mock current-user
F01 startup session 401 coverage can require at least one intercepted /bff/me request
